response.message: Astronomy Picture of the Day: The Great Nebula in Orion. This stunning image captures the Orion Nebula, a vast stellar nursery located about 1,344 light-years from Earth. The bright core is illuminated by young, hot stars whose intense ultraviolet radiation causes the surrounding gas to glow. Dark lanes of dust silhouette the glowing clouds, while thousands of newly forming stars remain hidden within. Professional explanation: The Orion Nebula is one of the most studied regions of star formation and offers a window into how our own solar system may have formed.
